# Hyprland build kit for Omarchy stable x86_64

This immutable kit rebuilds the optional Cua Hyprland plugin from
[Driver 0.26.1](https://github.com/trycua/cua/releases/tag/cua-driver-rs-v0.26.1)
against the measured `omarchy-stable-20260910` profile. It contains source,
packaging tools, checksums, and provenance—not a prebuilt or Omarchy-signed
plugin package.

- Source: `cc54254464c0c9aebfd6547fe7e4a0ceaf0456d7`.
- Tooling: `67f89ceb47edd973aa748820eadd02ddbfb3d3e4`, merged through
  [#3698](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/3698).
- Environment: Hyprland `0.56.2-2`, GCC `16.2.1 20260810`, and the exact
  compositor, header, compiler, and runtime identities in the profile.
- Qualified client/app pairing: actual Omarchy `cua-driver-bin 0.24.0-1`
  with native Wayland Inkscape `1.4.4-6`, two independent input lanes, and the
  canonical US keymap. The plugin version does not identify the tested Driver
  executable version.

Verify the archive against its published SHA-256 and review the profile before
using it. The kit requires mandatory build tests, exact compatibility checks,
deliberate activation, and a fresh compositor session for package replacement.
Its provenance intentionally does not assert native certification; the bounded
native evidence and limits are recorded separately in #3698.

[Omarchy #346](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy-pkgs/pull/346) remains the
downstream integration. Omabot replay, a named Omarchy release owner, deliberate
signing/publication, and a fresh signed-consumer check remain required. This
release does not make the optional plugin available through Omarchy's package
repository.

Install Sandbox with the optional typed Driver SDK:

```sh
pip install --extra-index-url https://wheels.cua.ai/simple 'cua-sandbox[driver]==0.5.0'
```
